title: Initialize Rust project and run baseline
description: Set up the Cargo workspace and verify it builds

title: Implement file ignore/shadowing logic
description: Implement the logic that differentiates between local files and shadowed files, updating .gitignore automatically.

title: Implement file tracker (add command)
description: Implement 'add' command to track local files in a '.shadowbox' file, which will also update .gitignore.

title: Create minimal Rust CLI skeleton
description: Set up main.rs with a basic 'hello' and ensure it compiles with cargo.

title: Integrate Clap for argument parsing
description: Add clap to Cargo.toml and define initial subcommands (track, status) as placeholders.

title: Add basic smoke test
description: Ensure 'cargo test' passes for the basic skeleton.

title: Rename 'add' subcommand to 'track' and implement path normalization
description: Rename the subcommand to 'track' and normalize the path to avoid duplicate entries like './file' and 'file'. Also, use the correct help message.

title: Add automated tests for 'track' and '.gitignore' integration
description: Add a new test case to 'tests/smoke_test.rs' or a new test file that verifies 'track' actually adds a file to '.shadowbox' and '.gitignore' without duplicates.

title: Implement 'untrack' command to remove entries from .shadowbox and .gitignore
description: Add 'untrack' subcommand to Cli. It should normalize the path and remove it from both .shadowbox and .gitignore. Ensure that if a file is already gone from gitignore it doesn't error. Acceptance criteria: 'shadowbox untrack file.txt' removes the line 'file.txt' from both files.

title: Implement 'status' command to list tracked files
description: Add 'status' subcommand. It should read .shadowbox and print each tracked file. Acceptance criteria: 'shadowbox status' prints a list of files currently in .shadowbox.

title: Handle edge cases for 'untrack'
description: Gracefully handle cases where 'untrack' is called on a file that isn't tracked or doesn't exist on disk (if we still allow untracking it). Acceptance criteria: 'shadowbox untrack unknown.txt' provides a clear error or info message and doesn't crash.

title: Add tests for 'untrack' and 'status'
description: Create tests in tests/untrack_test.rs or update existing tests. Acceptance criteria: Tests cover tracking, untracking, and listing status, including path normalization consistency.

title: Fix path normalization in src/main.rs
description: Refine normalize_path to handle '.', '..', and prevent empty returns that cause blanket deletions in state files. Add tests for edge cases.

title: Harden track/untrack logic
description: Improve track_file and untrack_file to handle missing files, duplicates, and invalid paths gracefully. Ensure atomic-like behavior for state updates.

title: Enhance 'status' to check for missing files
description: Update the status command to check if each tracked file exists on disk and mark it as [MISSING] if not. Acceptance criteria: 'shadowbox status' prints '[MISSING] file.txt' if file.txt is in .shadowbox but not on disk.

title: Add tests for status missing check
description: Verify that 'status' correctly identifies missing files in tests/status_test.rs.

title: Verify untrack edge cases
description: Ensure untrack handles already-untracked files and missing files gracefully.

title: Improve untrack test coverage
description: Add comprehensive tests for untracking in tests/untrack_test.rs.

title: Implement sync command
description: Refine the 'sync' command to read .shadowbox and ensure all its entries are present in .gitignore.

title: Implement init command
description: Implement the 'init' command to initialize a Shadowbox configuration and potentially offer hook installation.

title: Implement hooks subcommands
description: Implement 'hooks install' and 'hooks uninstall' to automatically setup git hooks that run 'shadowbox sync'.

title: Add integration tests for Step 3
description: Add automated tests that verify sync behavior and hook installation in a test repository environment.
